# Badge

A short label for a status, category or count, next to what it describes.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Brand expressive</span></p>

## When to use it

**In Brand expressive:** New and limited labels.

- **Use it when:** A state people scan for in a list or table, or a small category label.
- **Not when:** A message people must read (alert or toast), or an action (a button).

Instead:

- [Alert](./alert.md): A message, not a label.
- [Button](./button.md): Something to press.

## Why it works this way

Badge looks the way it does because of 4 answers about this product. Each card is one answer, in three steps: the answer, what it decided for Badge, and what would move if it changed.

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-content-q1"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What is the main content?</b><code>content.q1</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Images and campaigns</div><p>Images, campaigns and short punchy copy.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Badge</h5><ul><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>info</b>: Campaign labels are a state or a nudge; there are no plain news labels.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Empty: default</code> <code>Input group: block-start</code> <code>Input group: block-end</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Badge decision would reopen</small><p>and 10 answers that follow from it: <b>One idea at a time</b>, <b>Browse and explore</b>, <b>Regular</b>, and 7 more.</p></div></div></section>

## Words

- Headlines are short and bold. Three to six words.
- Verbs that move: Join, Try, Go.
- Playful in headlines, plain in errors.
- Use: Join, Drop, Go, Love. Avoid: Synergy, Leverage, Kindly.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Go
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Explore the drop

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

Test before you ship:

- [ ] The status is a word; color and icon add to it, never replace it. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add badge
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Component keys

The CSS variable is the key with `/` replaced by `-` and the base `@` dropped. Each key points to a token; values live only on primitives.

| Key | What it controls | Points to, light | Points to, dark |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `badge/radius` | Badge corner radius. | `radius.badge` → `brand-expressive.theme.base.radius.badge` → `radius.999` | same |
| `badge/padding-x` | Horizontal padding inside a badge. | `space.gap.tight` → `space.8` | same |
| `badge/font-size` | Badge label size. | `type.caption.font-size` → `font.size.14` | same |
| `badge/neutral/background` | Neutral badge fill. | `color.surface.sunken` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.color.surface.sunken` → `color.taupe.light.100` | `color.surface.sunken` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.color.surface.sunken` → `color.taupe.dark.100` |
